rights.source: Original authored procedural meshes and SVG illustrations created for this example; no external asset sources.
rights.notice: Inherits the repository's UNLICENSED status. This manifest grants no license or additional rights.

coordinates.nominalHeight: 3.69 units original; 4.33 units Seed; feet start near Y=0.16

rig.notes: Fixed order across both forms, duplicated seam vertices and degenerate pole triangles. Overlapping separate watertight-looking surfaces, not a single welded mesh. Shape vertices are interpolated in place and normals recomputed.

morphs.deformation: Head height/crown curl/width; torso width/height; arm attachment, reach and leaf-like profile; foot position. No whole-group scaling.

attachments.method: Sample each original and target surface at a stable (v, angle), then linearly interpolate and offset +Z by 0.025 units.
attachments.equipment: One badge, visible immediately when selected. Removed immediately on unequip while body reverses.

reuse: Source references are relative to this manifest in the repository, not promised HTTP source endpoints in dist. Import the example package's ./state, ./shape or ./assets exports in a TypeScript-aware bundler; Three.js is required only for ./assets. This example is not a core harness dependency.
limitations: Front-view fitting-room pose only; no skeletal animation or gameplay rig
No export pipeline or glTF assets
No topology guarantee across future versions
Fallback SVGs are interpretations, not identical GPU renders
Not tested across physical GPU vendors or non-Chromium browsers
